messages.en:
I'm picturing your goofy
face as I write this.
messages.et:
Kujutan kirjutades ette
su tobedat nägu.

messages.en:
How've you been? Me? Why?
What's it to ya?
messages.et:
Kuidas sul on läinud? Mina?
Miks? Mis sinu asi see on?

messages.en:
I can't forget that round
face of yours! Darn it!
messages.et:
Ma ei saa seda su ümarat
nägu unustada! Pagan!

messages.en:
Hey, it's me! ME! You
remember me, don't you?
messages.et:
Hei, mina siin! MINA! Sa
mäletad mind, kas pole?

messages.en:
That getup you wore the
other day. What was that?
messages.et:
See kostüüm, mida sa
tookord kandsid. Mis see?

messages.en:
Ever since you left, all I
do is look up at the sky.
messages.et:
Sinu lahkumisest saati
olen vaid taevasse vahtinud.

messages.en:
Your scent lingers around
the town. It's citrus-like.
messages.et:
Su lõhn hõljub linnas.
See on tsitruseline.

messages.en:
Hey! Hear me out for a
second, OK?
messages.et:
Hei! Kuula mind hetkeks
ära, eks?

messages.en:
How've you been? Tripping
over your own feet still?
messages.et:
Kuidas läheb? Kas komistad
ikka oma jalgade otsa?

messages.en:
Since you left, things've
been really quiet here.
messages.et:
Sinu lahkumisest saati on
siin olnud väga vaikne.

messages.en:
Do you like your town? It
stinks without me, right?
messages.et:
Kas su linn meeldib sulle?
Ilma minuta on see nõme?

messages.en:
There was something I
forgot to tell you.
messages.et:
Oli midagi, mida ma
unustasin sulle öelda.

messages.en:
It's outta the blue, but
you better like it!
messages.et:
See tuleb ootamatult, aga
sulle parem meeldigu!

messages.en:
I was so happy you visited
that I forgot to breathe.
messages.et:
Olin nii rõõmus, et sa
tulid, et unustasin hingata.

messages.en:
You're dying to visit our
town now, huh. I knew it!
messages.et:
Sa ihkad nüüd kohutavalt
meie linna tulla. Teadsin!
